name: 20155-longprefill-70bfp8-4gpu
hardware: 4x H100 80GB HBM3, four cards of one a3 node.
parallelism: TP=4, PP=1, DP=1, one engine on one node, NVLink only. PP=1 is pinned -- vLLM force-disables the sequence-parallel branch of this pass config under pipeline parallelism.
architecture: LlamaForCausalLM dense decoder, 80 layers, 64 query / 8 KV heads, head_dim 128, hidden 8192, intermediate 28672, 131072 window, llama3 rope scaling; compressed-tensors W8A8 fp8 linear weights and activations with static per-tensor scales, `lm_head` excluded, norms and KV bf16.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=1, warmup 10%, cooldown 10%, 300 requests, 1800 s safety cap, static seed 20155. streams=1 is load-bearing.
workload: synthetic `synthetic_text`, single turn, 8192 prompt tokens and exactly 32 output tokens on every request (min == max == mean on both). Prefix caching is off, so every request pays its own full prefill. The chat template adds a few tokens on the wire, so the engine counts ~8200 and schedules a ~10-token tail step after the 8192-token one.
purpose: A document analysis assistant summarizing book-length prompts into brief answers, one request at a time, on four GPUs.
launch:
# The engine's command line, as `key: value` lines only; a value beginning `{` or `[` is read as
# JSON. An indented YAML block never reaches AsyncEngineArgs, so `compilation-config` MUST stay on
# ONE line -- reflowed into a block mapping the key is dropped and the engine starts without it.

model: RedHatAI/Meta-Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct-FP8
tensor-parallel-size: 4
pipeline-parallel-size: 1
enable-prefix-caching: false
compilation-config: {"level": 3, "compile_sizes": [8192], "pass_config": {"enable_async_tp": true}}
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
max-model-len: 16384
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
num-gpu-blocks-override: 8192
dtype: bfloat16
